voice.noSpeech.title: Speech is not available
voice.noSpeech.text: Your account cannot use speech, so it cannot manage saved voices. Ask an administrator to turn it on.
speech.title: Speak text
speech.lede: Turn text into speech with a voice model of this server.
speech.noModelsLink: Get one from the model gallery.
speech.voicePlaceholder: Falante opcional ou ID de voz
speech.noAccess: Your account has no access to text-to-speech. The server will refuse the request.
voices.title: Vozes
voices.lede: Recognise who is speaking, and keep voices that text-to-speech can use.
voice.speaker: speaker
voice.whoLede: Matches a clip against the people you enrolled.
voice.sameLede: Two clips, one question. Nobody has to be enrolled.
voice.whoNote: Searches the speakers enrolled on this server. The clip you test with is not stored.
voice.sameNote: The answer comes from one voiceprint per clip. Nothing is stored.
voice.workingText: Comparing the clip with the voiceprints the server holds.
voice.matchText: {{name}}'s voiceprint is the closest of {{count}} compared, {{distance}} away. Anything under {{cutoff}} counts as the same person.
voice.missText: The closest was {{name}} at {{distance}}, past the cut-off of {{cutoff}}. That usually means a new speaker, or a clip that is too short or noisy.
voice.noneEnrolled: Nobody is enrolled to compare with
voice.noneEnrolledText: Enrol a speaker first, then identify a clip against them.
voice.noneReturnedText: It holds no voiceprints made with this model. If the server restarted, enrolled voices are gone: enrol them again.
voice.enrolIntro: The server keeps a voiceprint and a name. It does not keep the recording.
voice.emptyTitle: Nobody enrolled in this browser yet
voice.emptyText: Enrol a speaker with a short recording, then test a clip against them.
voice.agreedHint: I have their permission, or another lawful basis, to store a voiceprint of them.
voice.keepHint: Lets you replay it and enrol again after a server restart. Off by default. It is stored in this browser only.
voice.neededText: Voice recognition turns a recording into a voiceprint and compares voiceprints. It runs on a speaker-recognition model, and none is installed on this server.
voice.neededWhat: Install a model that supports speaker recognition. Once one is installed, this page turns on by itself. Users also need the Voice recognition permission.
voice.moreHint: guess a speaker's traits, get the raw voiceprint
voice.why.0: One speaker is assumed. A clip with two people mixes both voices.
voice.why.1: A different microphone or room changes how a voice sounds.
voice.why.2: This is a similarity score, not a security check. Do not use it to unlock anything.
voice.stored.0.what: A {{print}} (numbers that describe the voice, not the audio), a name and your labels. They are kept in memory, are shared by everyone who uses this server, and are lost when it restarts. The recording is not kept.
voice.stored.1.what: The name, labels and time of each person you enrolled. A copy of the recording only if you tick Keep a copy when enrolling.
voice.stored.2.what: They go to the model on this server to be compared and are not kept.
cutoff.label: Cut-off
cutoff.explain: Stricter means fewer wrong matches and more misses. The answer above updates as you move it. The server is not asked again.
why.title: Why this might be wrong
why.short: The clip is short: {{s}} s. Three seconds or more of speech works better.
known.caption: People saved in this browser, with their {{noun}} state
known.name: Nome
known.goneText: The last search did not return this person. The server may have restarted, so the {{print}} is gone, or it was enrolled with another model.
known.extraText: The server returned this person but this browser has no record of them.
known.note: This list is kept in this browser. The server has no list call, so it cannot be checked until you run a search.
known.noteSearched: This list is kept in this browser. The last search checked it against the server; a person it did not return is marked.
enrol.name: Nome
enrol.labelsHint: optional, one per line as key: value
enrol.asSpeech: Also keep it as a speech voice
enrol.asSpeechHint: Text-to-speech can then speak in this voice. Needs the exact transcript.
enrol.keep: Keep a copy in this browser

voiceLibrary.title: Biblioteca de Vozes
voiceLibrary.subtitle: Crie e gerencie vozes de referência reutilizáveis para cada modelo instalado que suporta clonagem de voz.
voiceLibrary.loadFailed: Speech voices could not be loaded
voiceLibrary.summary.label: Status da biblioteca de vozes
voiceLibrary.search.label: Buscar perfis de voz
voiceLibrary.empty.title: Sua biblioteca de vozes está vazia
voiceLibrary.empty.body: Grave ou envie um clipe de referência autorizado, adicione a transcrição exata e reuse-o nos modelos de TTS compatíveis.
voiceLibrary.noResults.title: Nenhuma voz corresponde a estes filtros
voiceLibrary.noResults.body: Tente uma busca diferente ou mostre todos os idiomas.
voiceLibrary.detail.emptyBody: Áudio de referência, transcrição, compatibilidade e detalhes de consentimento aparecerão aqui.
voiceLibrary.consent.label: Permission
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.title: Instalar um modelo de clonagem de voz
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.body: Esta voz está pronta, mas precisa de um modelo que aceite áudio de referência. Escolha um verificado por este servidor.
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.loading: Encontrando modelos compatíveis em suas galerias…
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.loadFailed: Recomendações compatíveis não puderam ser carregadas.
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.noneAvailable: Nenhum modelo compatível não instalado está disponível nas galerias configuradas.
voiceLibrary.modelSetup.capabilityNote: As recomendações vêm dos metadados de capacidade do modelo, não de uma lista de modelos do lado do navegador.
voiceLibrary.api.title: Uso da API e modelos compatíveis
voiceLibrary.api.summary: Use esta voz fora do navegador ou verifique o suporte do modelo
voiceLibrary.api.body: Envie a URI de voz estável do perfil com cada requisição de fala. O LocalAI resolve o áudio de referência privado e a transcrição no momento da geração; as configurações dos seus modelos não são alteradas.
voiceLibrary.api.noInstalledModels: Nenhum ainda. Instale um dos modelos verificados pelo servidor acima antes de enviar esta requisição.
voiceLibrary.api.endpointNote: Os mesmos campos de modelo, entrada e voz também funcionam com POST /tts.
voiceLibrary.deleteDialog.title: Excluir esta voz?
voiceLibrary.deleteDialog.message: “{{name}}” e seu áudio de referência serão removidos permanentemente. Os modelos configurados com esta voz não são alterados.
voiceLibrary.toasts.installStarted: Instalando {{name}}. O progresso está disponível em Operações.
voiceLibrary.toasts.installFailed: Não foi possível iniciar a instalação: {{message}}
voiceLibrary.toasts.copyFailed: Não foi possível copiar a requisição de API
voiceCreate.title: Criar uma voz reutilizável
voiceCreate.subtitle: Adicione um clipe de referência limpo e sua transcrição exata. O LocalAI cuida dos parâmetros de clonagem específicos do backend no momento da geração.
voiceCreate.sections.reference.title: Áudio de referência
voiceCreate.sections.reference.body: Grave no navegador ou envie um clipe existente. A fala deve ser limpa, natural e de um único falante.
voiceCreate.sections.details.title: Identidade e transcrição
voiceCreate.sections.details.body: Dê à voz um nome reconhecível e transcreva o clipe exatamente, incluindo hesitações e pontuação.
voiceCreate.sections.consent.title: Autorização
voiceCreate.sections.consent.body: A clonagem de voz pode ser sensível. Confirme a permissão antes que esta referência seja salva.
voiceCreate.audio.label: Referência de voz
voiceCreate.audio.tooLarge: This file is larger than 50 MiB.
voiceCreate.audio.durationError: O áudio de referência deve ter entre 1 segundo e 2 minutos.
voiceCreate.audio.decodeError: Este navegador não conseguiu decodificar o arquivo de áudio selecionado.
voiceCreate.audio.qualityHint: 6–30 segundos geralmente produzem um clone mais forte
voiceCreate.fields.name: Nome da voz
voiceCreate.fields.transcriptPlaceholder: Digite cada palavra falada no clipe de referência…
voiceCreate.fields.transcriptHint: Corresponda à gravação exatamente. Não reescreva a gramática nem remova pausas e hesitações.
voiceCreate.consent.title: Confirmo que esta voz pode ser clonada
voiceCreate.consent.body: Tenho a permissão do falante ou outra base legal para armazenar e usar esta gravação para fala sintetizada.
voiceCreate.readiness.title: Prontidão do perfil
voiceCreate.readiness.body: Uma voz fica disponível em Texto para Fala quando todos os itens obrigatórios estão completos.
voiceCreate.readiness.name: Nome de voz reconhecível
voiceCreate.privacy.title: Privada por padrão.
voiceCreate.privacy.body: O áudio de referência é armazenado no diretório de dados do LocalAI com permissões de arquivo restritas e nunca é exposto como um caminho de pasta de modelo.
clip.blocked: The {{thing}} is blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings and try again, or choose a file instead.
clip.insecure: A browser only opens the {{thing}} on https or on localhost. You are on {{origin}}. Open this page through localhost or add TLS, or choose a file.
clip.unsupported: This browser cannot open the {{thing}}. Choose a file instead.
clip.missing: No {{thing}} was found on this device. Choose a file instead.
clip.failed: The {{thing}} could not be opened. Choose a file instead.
same.text: The two {{print}}s are {{distance}} apart. Anything under {{cutoff}} counts as the same person.
scale.aria: Distance scale with the cut-off at {{cutoff}}. Lower means more alike. {{dots}}
scale.axis: distance between {{print}}s, lower means more alike
how.title: How to read this.
how.body: Distance is how far apart two {{print}}s are, 0 meaning identical. The cut-off is the line between same and different. The word Strong or Likely says how far inside the line a result sits. It is not a probability.
stored.title: What is stored, and where
toast.enrolledBoth: Enrolled {{name}} and saved a speech voice
toast.tooBig: The copy was too large for browser storage, so it was not kept.
toast.speechFailed: Enrolled, but the speech voice could not be saved: {{message}}
toast.alreadyGone: {{name}} was already gone from the server.
needed.noneListed: No matching model is listed in the galleries.
needed.askAdmin: Ask an administrator to install one.
off.voice.title: Voice recognition is off for your account
off.voice.text: An administrator has not allowed you to use voice recognition.
off.voice.what: An administrator can turn on the Voice recognition permission for your user in Users and keys.
recording.title: Name the speakers in a recording
recording.text: The diarization workspace finds who spoke when in a recording. From there you can remember a speaker, and that voice joins the Speakers list here.
recording.step1: Open the workspace, add a recording and tick Prepare speakers to remember.
recording.step2: Run diarization. Each speaker with enough clean speech gets a Name and remember button.
recording.step3: Name a speaker and remember it. That voice then appears under Speakers, ready for Who is this.
recording.off: Diarization is not turned on for your account.
recording.warning: Remembered voices are shared on this server and are lost when it restarts. Nothing is remembered automatically.
